answer_1.quote: We explore a more challenging scenario in which a diagnostic model, acting as an independent medical expert, predicts diagnoses from patient data only without relying on the doctor's textual diagnosis conclusion.
answer_1.outputs: ICD codes predicted from clinical text and patient history

answer_2.quote: We report accuracy and the micro-averaged precision, recall, F1-score.

answer_4.quote: All data annotations in this paper are newly created. Dataset annotation was conducted by annotators, and there are no associated concerns (e.g. regarding compensation).
answer_4.guideline: The purpose of the annotation is to assign the correct, most private (to the extent possible from the limited anamnesis cotext) identifier to each nosologic unit represented in the diagnosis.
